name: project-memory
description: Portable, token-efficient Markdown memory for ongoing projects.

interface.longDescription: Creates and maintains self-contained Markdown project memory with selective loading, health checks, session receipts, and portability safeguards.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-memory to initialize memory for this project.
Use $project-memory to report the current project status.
Use $project-memory to close this work session safely.
